facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/re.create_env: create a vectorized GymEnv wrapping multiple gym environments with TimeLimit and an optional seed
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/re.create_agent: create a DIAYNAgent instance from a given model and number of actions
facebookresearch_rlstructures/rlalgos/re.run_DIAYN_experiment: run a DIAYN reinforcement learning experiment on CartPole-v0 using the Experiment class and config dict
